say:1:1524649001:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the hunters reported signs of a massive beast near the tribe.

say:2:1524649002:1.text: As it could pose a threat to the tribe, they plan to organize a group hunt to catch it soon.
say:2:1524649002:1.source_cn: 狩猎队判断它有可能会威胁到部落，打算近期组织一次集体围猎。
say:2:1524649002:1.male: As it could pose a threat to the tribe, they plan to organize a group hunt to catch it soon.
say:2:1524649002:1.female: As it could pose a threat to the tribe, they plan to organize a group hunt to catch it soon.

say:3:1524649003:1.text: And they need a powerful mage to assist them.
say:3:1524649003:1.source_cn: 他们担心狩猎会很困难，所以提出希望有实力强大的魔法师一...

say:3:1524649003:1.female: And they need a powerful mage to assist them.

say:4:1524649004:1.text: But we still don't have any mages skilled enough to hold their own...
say:4:1524649004:1.source_cn: 您知道的，雅库伯尔目前还未培养出足以独当一面的魔法师……
